title: Oil-Filled Space Heater Has Desirable Safety Features, Odd Snap-On Feet
text:
Oil-Filled Space Heater Has Desirable Safety Features, Odd Snap-On Feet. Space heaters of all kinds make me nervous, and this NEWAIR PORTABLE INDOOR SMALL ELECTRIC HEATER (NIH040WH00) (with Silent, Energy Efficient Operation, White) is no exception. It has desirable safety features--automatic shutoff function, tipover kill switch--but it has snap-on feet that leave me wondering about its stability.

If an oil-filled heater tips over or leaks, it can cause a fire. Oil-filled heaters stay warm for some time after they are turned off (which adds to their energy efficiency), but it also means they can set fire to combustible items (e.g., fabrics) that contact them even after they are turned off. Generally, combustible items should be kept at least 3 feet away from any oil-filled heater, even if the heater’s surface remains cool.

Given the safety issues surrounding oil-filled heaters, I’m NOT comfortable using this one (or any other model). I was interested in this model because of the slim panel design and small size, but it was a mistake for me to order it.
